title: ITZ Payload Operations - Inbound Receipt, Outbound Dispatch, and Return
reference_docs: DHS CRADA [ref]; Butte ITZ MOA; ITAR 22 CFR 120-130; EAR 15 CFR 730-774; CBP / Foreign-Trade Zone regulations (19 CFR Part 146); EXOS-ITZ-001; EXOS-ITZ-002. Empowered Official: John Quinn; ITAR reviewer: Denise Shirey.
remarks: DRAFT for review. Legal framework = customs/FTZ + U.S. export control. Support-cost schedule for payload-handling activities included in Task 6 (rates [TBD]). No controlled technical data handled outside authorized channels.
objective: establish the controlled process for receiving international payloads into the ITZ container, dispatching (loading out) payloads, and processing final returns, in compliance with customs / Foreign-Trade Zone and U.S. export-control (ITAR / EAR) requirements.
overview: This procedure governs the payload lifecycle at the ITZ container: pre-receipt compliance screening, inbound receipt and custody, in-container handling, outbound dispatch, and final return, with the legal framework and support-cost accounting for each activity.

tasks.name: Task 1 - Pre-receipt authorization and compliance screen
steps: Screen the payload, consignor, and parties against ITAR/EAR and denied/sanctioned-party lists; document the export jurisdiction/classification.
Confirm customs/FTZ entry treatment and required CBP documentation (19 CFR 146).
Verify any required DDTC authorization/license and confirm conformance with the DHS CRADA.
Control and screen foreign-person access for the specific payload (deemed-export check).

tasks.name: Task 2 - Inbound payload receipt into the container
steps: Verify the inbound consignment against the manifest; conduct customs-supervised entry as required.
Inspect condition and seals; photograph and record exceptions.
Enter the payload into the chain-of-custody log and apply tamper-evident seals (EXOS-ITZ-002).
Place into secure, monitored storage within the container.

tasks.name: Task 3 - In-container handling and staging
steps: Handle payloads per customer and hazard requirements; maintain environmental conditions.
Restrict access to authorized, trained personnel; log all handling.
Stage for outbound movement per schedule.

tasks.name: Task 4 - Outbound dispatch (loading payloads out)
steps: Confirm outbound authorization and export documentation/license as applicable.
Package, seal, and label per requirements; update the chain-of-custody log.
Complete customs/FTZ documentation for removal.
Hand off to the carrier and record the transfer and seal numbers.

tasks.name: Task 5 - Final return processing
steps: Receive the returned payload; verify condition, seals, and disposition against records.
Reconcile customs/FTZ status for the return; complete required documentation.
Release/return to the customer or dispose per instructions; close the chain-of-custody record.

tasks.name: Task 6 - Records, legal framework, and support-cost accounting
steps: Retain customs, export-control, custody, and handling records per the records schedule.
Confirm the activity complied with the customs/FTZ and ITAR/EAR framework; note any exceptions to the Empowered Official.

Record support-cost items for the activity - e.g., crane/rigging and receiving labor, security monitoring, payload handling/staging, customs broker/FTZ fees, storage, and consumables - to the ITZ support-cost schedule (rates [TBD]).
